data.title: Back-office and software teams in *Vietnam and Cebu*
data.lead: Harbourline Ops runs bookkeeping, data processing and software teams for companies in Australia, the UK and the US, from three offices in Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh City and Cebu.

data.title: One operations company, *three offices*
paragraphs: Harbourline Ops started in 2015 with a **bookkeeping desk in Da Nang** for two accounting firms in Sydney. Today 380 staff run finance, data and software work for 70 clients from three offices.
Every team works inside the client's own systems and has **a named team lead and a monthly review**. All three offices run on the same security controls.
points: Named team lead for every client

head.title: Our services
head.lead: Three service lines run from every office, so one contract can cover a bookkeeping desk and a software squad.

cards.title: Bookkeeping and payroll
cards.text: Accountants close the month in Xero and QuickBooks, prepare payroll and send every file through a reviewer before it leaves the desk.

cards.title: Data processing
cards.text: Operators extract, check and load invoice, order and claim data into your systems, with daily counts and error rates.

cards.title: Software squads
cards.text: Engineers build and test web products in your repositories and join your sprint planning and demos.

cards.title: Customer support
cards.text: Email and chat support in English during Australian, UK or US business hours, on your help desk.

head.title: Three delivery centres
head.lead: Each office runs the same security controls and the same review steps, so a team can grow in one city and keep its routine.
